about_the_game:
One day not unlike other days, your father asks you to go get your sister, dinner is ready. As the faithful child you are you get a weapon and stride out the door for the way could be long and filled with dangers. 

Don't Go Unarmed is an action-RPG roguelite where you start off by choosing your weapon which will determine your stats and what talents you will have at your disposal. Will you choose the bow, Setting traps and have the range advantage? Maybe close and personal is more of your style and the sword might suit you better. Which ever you end up picking the journey to get your sister home for dinner will be a long and difficuly one.

Every floor is randomly generated and filled with enemies and secrets both. To succeed you must grasp at every advantage you can find. Defeat monsters to level up, find upgrades to boost your attacks, seach for gold and spend it in the shops. Defeat the boss that marks the end of every biome, do all this and you might stand a chance. 

And if you, as many others before you, end up with your health depleted... you can always try again and maybe this time with new unlocked content.

short_description: Don't Go Unarmed is a randomly generated action RPG shooter with heavy Rogue-like elements. Combine upgrades, items and talents in new ways each run, to defeat all the different enemies you'll be facing throughout the forests, caves and beyond...
